Package com.helix.cli.repl

Class BytecodeDisassembler

java.lang.Object
com.helix.cli.repl.BytecodeDisassembler
public class BytecodeDisassembler extends Object
Disassembles compiled JVM bytecode into human-readable HotSpot assembly representation matching javap -v output, powered by ASM's TraceClassVisitor.
